meta.title: strQ.app: Consistency rewarded
meta.description: You know that moment. Halfway through training, and the couch wins. strQ helps you keep going.

hero.subtitle: Halfway through training, and the couch wins.

about.heading: What is strQ
about.intro: strQ is a gamified fitness app that rewards consistency on the road to your sports event. No coach, no logger, no training plan. Just a streak that keeps you going. For ambitious recreational athletes who refuse to drop off halfway through. Public launch in 2026.
